newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Simplot Australia unit in I&J unit merger.
newsitem.headline: Simplot Australia unit in I&J unit merger.

text.p: U.S. owned food group Simplot Australia said it has merged its Simplot's Seafood, Snack and Meal division with I&J Foods Ltd, a unit of South African food group Irvin & Johnson Ltd.
Simplot Australia, which is privately owned by Idaho potato magnate John Simplot, said the merger will be effective September 1, 1997 with the merged group sales to be around A$200 million.
Simplot will own 60 percent of the merged group and I&J Foods 40 percent, Simplot said.

"The merger between the two businesses places both partners in a much stronger position for profitable growth with the opportunity to capitalise on export markets, particularly Asia," Simplot Australia managing director Walter Bugno said in a statement.

"International partnerships such as this are part of Simplot Australia's strategy to continue to drive the organisation towards becoming an internationally competitive, low-cost and innovative food manufacturer and marketer," he said.
Growth in the Australian food market was static, he said.
"While there are shifts in consumption patterns, the domestic market is not going to provide the returns needed in the future," Bugno said.
